summary: Implemented the show_speed feature in rich/progress.py: TaskProgressColumn gained a show_speed option (default False), a class-level render_speed classmethod using filesize.pick_unit_and_suffix, and unknown-total rendering that shows speed; track() gained show_speed (default True) and passes it to the column; Progress.track no longer raises for unsized iterables and types its inferred total as Optional[float]. Added a CHANGELOG Unreleased/Added line, removed the two ValueError assertions in test_track and test_progress_track, and added test_task_progress_column_speed. Nothing was run (no tests, mypy, or repository code), and nothing was committed.
